dataset.description:
The code developed within the FairOnChain project is essential for enabling the extraction, processing, analysis, and sharing of blockchain data. This includes scripts for raw data extraction from blockchain nodes, transformation into structured formats, and the creation of secondary datasets such as labeled or aggregated data.

The codebase also powers key functionalities, including:

    Data access APIs for both primary and secondary datasets.
    Automation pipelines for metadata generation and dataset versioning.
    Integration with decentralized storage systems (e.g., IPFS) for efficient dataset distribution.

The primary purpose of this code is to ensure the reproducibility of workflows, scalability of data management processes, and alignment with FAIR principles. It will be made open-source to encourage reuse, collaboration, and innovation in the blockchain research community.

dataset.description: This description outlines the data management activities related to the collection, structuring, and sharing of blockchain transaction data from major networks (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum). The goal is to ensure compliance with FAIR principles by providing standardized APIs and open datasets for research and societal use. Key activities include data curation, metadata enrichment, and access control to balance openness with resource constraints.

dmp.description: The objective of this project is to develop a publicly accessible infrastructure that enables easy access and searchability of blockchain data in accordance with the FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Replicable) of open science. This infrastructure aims to promote complete transparency and reproducibility of scientific analysis results in the blockchain field, thereby facilitating the growth and collaboration of new and existing applications.
